main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean 3-bar excess return

statistic.name: t of weighted mean, same-day cases pooled

main_measure.threshold: confirm: above 0 with t >= 2 (and slope > 0); reject: below 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of 3-bar excess return on forecast

decided_by: The forecast-weighted mean excess return is above 0 with t >= 2 and the slope on the forecast is positive.
reading: Situation = raw distance above prior 20-day closing high > 0 (recomputed from closes where not recorded) and, where 60 bars of the window exist, a positive 60-bar price change as the rising profile, side long; the plan's 'fewer than 30 cases on distinct days' is applied as a minimum count (not observable), the weighted-mean t pools each day's weighted deviations, and the slope is an ordinary least-squares slope of excess return on forecast over all cases.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.02174 on the check folds against +0.03612 on every fold
